- Add explicit wizard selection for resource table columns. Selected numbers become counters; dice values become reminders. Schema-defined spell, slot and optional-selection progressions are excluded, and new free-form columns start unselected.
- Combine a selected counter with a dice reminder from the same source, keeping one stable resource identity and an editable name.
- Preserve manual edits per resource field while untouched counts and dice continue to follow the selected class level. Keep spent uses, feature/spell links and manual recovery settings.
- Keep manually deleted imports removed, and protect deselected pools that are edited, spent or still linked. Preserve older edited imports conservatively when field history is unavailable.
- Support explicit dice tags such as Soulknife's Die Size without inferring values from prose or dynamic formulas.
- Validation: The complete suite passed with 966 product tests and 9 tooling checks. All 69 targeted wizard checks passed after the final mapping-intent refinement.
